scientific_integrity: Exactly two antipodal punctures of the binary five-cube at scale three. Full and one-point homotopy and link statements are cited as previously covered in Feng 2023; only the double-puncture exact collapse and its maps are new. Finite exhaustive certificates are included and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: No classification of non-antipodal two-point removals
Only dimension five and scale three
title: Antipodal two-point punctures erase all seven-dimensional five-cube Rips homology
